title: Joel Bible Quiz - Chapter 3
description: Ten questions on Joel 3: the valley of Jehoshaphat, the nations called to war and the hills flowing with milk.

questions.text: Where will God gather all the nations, according to verse 2?
questions.explanation: He says he will gather all nations and bring them down into the valley of Jehoshaphat, and execute judgment on them there.

questions.text: For what does verse 3 say a girl was sold?
questions.explanation: They cast lots for his people, gave a boy for a prostitute and sold a girl for wine, that they might drink.

questions.text: Which two cities does God address in verse 4, together with the regions of Philistia?
questions.explanation: He asks Tyre, Sidon and all the regions of Philistia what they are to him, and whether they will repay him.

questions.text: To whom had they sold the children of Judah and Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: They took his silver and gold and sold the children of Judah and the children of Jerusalem to the sons of the Greeks.

questions.text: What are the nations told to beat their plowshares into?
questions.explanation: The nations are told to beat their plowshares into swords and their pruning hooks into spears.

questions.text: What is the weak one told to say in verse 10?
questions.explanation: Verse 10 says, 'Let the weak say, “I am strong.”'

questions.text: Why are they told to put in the sickle, according to verse 13?
questions.explanation: They are told to put in the sickle because the harvest is ripe, and to tread, because the wine press is full.

questions.text: What does verse 14 call the valley full of multitudes?
questions.explanation: Verse 14 speaks of multitudes in the valley of decision, for the day of Yahweh is near there.

questions.text: From where will Yahweh roar, according to verse 16?
questions.explanation: Yahweh will roar from Zion and thunder from Jerusalem, but he will be a refuge to his people.

questions.text: What will the hills flow with in that day, according to verse 18?
questions.explanation: In that day the mountains will drop down sweet wine and the hills will flow with milk.
